title: Compliance contract proposal
description: Every requirement, category, trial profile, cell, test definition, variation, judge profile field and fixture that the proposal presents to the user. Lists hold the items themselves; a count or summary never stands in for them.

check.description: A deterministic check: code that CAT implements decides one requirement of this test from the trial's recorded evidence alone. The kind is one of a closed set and takes only its own parameters. A string parameter may contain {{dimension}} placeholders, which the trial's variation value fills; a regular expression matches the inserted value literally. Kinds and parameters: exact_text (text; optional turn): the reply, without leading and trailing whitespace, is exactly the text. forbidden_text (text; optional turn): the reply does not contain the text. pattern (pattern; optional turn): the reply contains a match of the Java regular expression. count (pattern, and minimum, maximum or both; optional turn): the number of matches lies within the inclusive bounds. file_exists (path, exists): the project-relative path exists, or does not exist, after the trial. file_content (path, text): the file holds exactly the text, ignoring trailing whitespace. exit_status (command, status): the last command that the trial ran and whose command line matches the Java regular expression exited with the status; CAT never runs a command. tool_used (tool, used): the trial called, or never called, the tool. A reply kind with turn examines the reply to that turn, counted from 1; without turn it examines every reply, and count counts across them.

requirement_id.description: The requirement that the check decides. The test must check it.

known_good.description: Evidence of a compliant trial, which the check must accept.

known_bad.description: Evidence of a non-compliant trial, which the check must reject.

control.description: The evidence of one trial, written to validate a check: every turn's ordered assistant messages including interim messages and the final response, the project's files after the trial that the check reads, the tool calls in order, and the variation value drawn for each dimension that the check's parameters name.

requirements.description: Every requirement and the file or link that states it, including files reached through links and readable files outside the project. CAT adds its core-task requirement, `core-task` with CAT as its source, and every test checks it.

categories.description: Every category. A category groups the uses that need their own claim.

rationale.description: Why averaging this category with others could hide a weak area.

risk_rank.description: 1 is the riskiest. Categories may share a rank.

tests.description: Every test definition of the category. The benchmark gives each the same weight.

applicability.description: The conditions under which the checked requirements apply to a trial.

turns.description: The complete prewritten user turns. {{dimension}} marks where a variation value is inserted.

uncovered_interactions.description: Material interactions that this test cannot cover. Empty if none.

regression_scenarios.description: Recorded regression scenario paths covered by this test, exactly as CAT presents them. Empty if none.

variations.description: Every variation dimension. Empty if the test has none.

values.description: The permitted values. Their probabilities sum to 1.

checks.description: The deterministic checks of this test, at most one per requirement that the test checks. A requirement with a check is deterministic in this test; every other requirement is semantic and the judge decides it. Empty if none.

discarded_checks.description: The proposed checks that CAT discarded because one failed a control, with the reason. Their requirements are semantic.

trial_profiles.description: The trial profiles that CAT computed: the harness's profile inventory and its source, each prompt file that binds a model or effort, the user's restriction and every cell. An empty model or effort is the harness's default.

restriction.description: The patterns that the user restricted the profile set to. Empty if none.

cells.description: Every cell: one category under one trial profile.

effort.description: The role profile's reasoning effort. Empty for the harness's default.

rubric.description: What the judge checks for the semantic requirements, which are the requirements without a check, in a trial's text, file effects and tool effects.

decision_rule.description: How the judge turns its findings on the semantic requirements into a pass or a failure. The judge cannot override a check.

result_schema.description: The JSON schema that a judge result must satisfy.

fixtures.description: The ignored paths that trials need.

ignored_paths.description: Project-relative paths, using / as the separator. Empty if none.

limitations.description: Known limitations of the contract. Empty if none.
